scope: Locked third-party Python artifacts for the synthetic OpenHands server candidate. No installation, extraction, build, VM operation, provider call or isolation claim.

limitations: Not an installed environment or proof of transitive/import compatibility.
OpenHands workspace source and pinned build tools are separate inputs.
func-timeout sdist needs an isolated build with separately frozen build dependencies.
browser-use, posthog and docker Python distributions remain in the pinned dependency closure; tool/runtime disabling needs deployed evidence.
All published wheel archive tags and runtime dependency metadata must be rechecked before installation.
selection.method: Evaluate exported PEP 508 markers against explicit Linux target; prefer first matching CPython/abi3/pure wheel tag, otherwise retain hash-pinned sdist. Uses installed pip vendored packaging 26.2; no dependency resolver or package code executed.
